# PackedHashtableOptimization

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="info" text="PHP ≥ 7.0" />

Group: [Performance](/rules/#performance) · PhpStorm name: `PackedHashtableOptimizationInspection`

Since PHP 7 an array whose keys are integers inserted in ascending order can
be stored in a compact "packed" layout. An array literal that lists integer
keys out of order (numeric-string keys count as the integers PHP stores
them as) misses that layout. Sorting the keys lets the engine use it.

## Example

```php{2,5,8}
<?php
$grid = [
    5 => 'e', 3 => 'c', 9 => 'i'
];
$cells = array(
    -1 => 'a', -4 => 'b', 0 => 'c', 2 => 'd'
);
$mixed = array('7' => 1, '2' => 2, 9 => 3);

$names = ['3' => 'x', 4 => 'y', '8' => 'z']; // already stored as integers
$small = [2 => 'b', 1 => 'a'];
$sorted = [1 => 'a', 2 => 'b', 2 => 'c'];
$labels = ['3' => 'x', 'label' => 'y', 5 => 'z'];
$padded = ['07' => 'x', 8 => 'y', 9 => 'z'];
$dyn = [$k => 1, 4 => 2, 6 => 3];
$plain = ['a', 'b', 'c'];
$float = [3.5 => 'a', 2 => 'b', 1 => 'c'];
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Sort the integer keys ascending so the array can be stored packed.</li>
<li>line 5: Sort the integer keys ascending so the array can be stored packed.</li>
<li>line 8: Sort the integer keys ascending so the array can be stored packed.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "PackedHashtableOptimization": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore PackedHashtableOptimization

/**
 * @noinspection PackedHashtableOptimizationInspection
 */
```
